note: A connection invitation from the same sender domain and even the same sender name. It is not a message: the invite is actionable only inside LinkedIn, and the Playwright path (US-C10) covers it, so it must not become a 'new message arrived' item.

raw.body:
Subject: Dana Lee wants to connect

Dana Lee sent you an invitation to connect on LinkedIn.

View invitation: https://www.linkedin.com/comm/mynetwork/invitation-manager/

https://www.linkedin.com/in/dana-lee-8b1c2
